summary: The note describes the 'Green Start-up Revolution', in which young eco-conscious entrepreneurs build sustainability-focused SMEs, often while still in school. It profiles founders and ventures such as EarthPack, SolarSprint and CircuTech, and explains the roles of education, mentorship, partnerships and green finance in supporting them. It concludes that these young founders are catalysts for environmental and social change.
one_line: Young eco-entrepreneurs are founding sustainability-driven SMEs, supported by education, mentorship, and green funding, as part of a growing Green Start-up Revolution.
key_facts: Mia Tang turned her science project on biodegradable materials into EarthPack, founded in November 2023, a company for sustainable packaging.
EarthPack uses agricultural waste to make packaging that decomposes within months, unlike plastic which can take hundreds of years to break down.
Joshua Omotoye, a 16-year-old, founded SolarSprint in January 2024, which innovates in solar-powered transportation.
Young founders are invested in the triple bottom line: people, planet, and profit.
The Green Innovator's Challenge, held in October 2023, had dozens of student teams compete on sustainable business plans, with winners receiving seed funding from ecofocused investors.
Anna Zhao, a veteran of the sustainable fashion industry, established the 'Green Business Beacon' mentorship program in December 2023 for students starting eco-conscious businesses.
17-year-old Xavier Mendes found an investor for his water conservation app AquaSave at a Green Start-up Fair in early 2024.
Lina Kim's 'GrowGreens' partnered with local organic farmers to source ingredients for plant-based snacks, launched in April 2024.
Eric Li, 17, founded CircuTech in June 2024; it specializes in recycling electronic waste in line with circular economy principles.
The EcoStart Grant, introduced by the government in September 2023, has aided over 50 youth-led SMEs, including Sarah Obi's sustainable beekeeping initiative.
Sarah Obi, 15, runs a sustainable beekeeping initiative that received EcoStart Grant support.
Green venture capital funds are on the rise, with some focusing exclusively on youth-led sustainable enterprises.
Emma Cortez's 'EcoEduKit', started in March 2024, offers schools educational kits that simplify complex environmental issues.
School curricula after September 2023 have increasingly emphasized sustainability and environmentalism.
